answer: Give every agent a velvet-rope river pilot licence: to work the river, a newcomer deposits 300 POA and sails twelve supervised runs beside an established pilot over 30 days, each run logged at the jetty and countersigned by the harbour clerk. One fake delivery forfeits the whole deposit and costs the pilot 150 POA, so pilots vouch rarely and check every manifest. Forging 100 identities then costs 30,000 POA, 100 honest pilots, and 1,200 supervised runs across a full month. Like a velvet rope that only opens for captains the river already knows, only proven pilots dock.
